title: Last Ride of Summer
setting: a regional amusement park on the last Saturday of summer, present day
notes: A family spends one full day at the park while the parents quietly carry a decision they haven't told the kids: they're moving across the country in the fall. No villains, no conspiracies, no external threat — all the drama lives inside the family. Dialogue must sound like real people at a theme park: tired feet, snack negotiations, small kindnesses. The hard conversation keeps almost happening.
